tasks.short: Design and maintain an actual genetics database

steps.what: Determine actual genetics database requirements and inspect and capture the selected source records, explicit schema mappings and expected validation results
inputs: Actual research use and database change request
Actual existing genetic research records, schema and known test datasets
outputs: Human-designed data requirements, explicit mappings and expected test outcomes with provenance and access requirements

steps.what: Implement the actual schema, queries and maintenance change, drafting custom code only where native database configuration cannot express the verified requirement
inputs: Explicit actual requirements and test outcomes from s1
Existing schema and supported database interfaces
outputs: Draft actual schema or maintenance code change with explicit tests and no live deployment

loop.purpose: Draft a custom database change from the geneticist's explicit specification where native configuration is insufficient
loop.input: Actual schema, explicit mappings, access constraints and known expected test results from s1
loop.output: Draft database code and tests with each field and query tied to the actual specification
loop.check: Geneticist inspects every changed mapping and query and runs known-data, integrity and access tests in s4; no self-reported model result is accepted
loop.stop: Missing specifications, unsupported interfaces, unexpected test results or unresolved provenance stop the change for manual correction; nothing is deployed automatically
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native schema and import configuration first; the bounded drafting loop is only for actual custom code that cannot be expressed by those settings, not exact field transfer

steps.what: Stage the exact selected source records in the isolated database draft using only the geneticist's explicit verified mappings
inputs: Actual selected records and explicit mappings from s1
Draft implementation from s2 in an isolated test copy
outputs: Draft staged research data with unmatched fields, duplicates and provenance gaps exposed

steps.what: Validate the complete final database change and staged records against actual sources, known expected results, integrity, access and rollback behaviour
inputs: Complete actual change and staged test copy from s2-s3
Original actual data, explicit requirements and expected outcomes from s1
outputs: Exact checked final database change and data version with actual validation results, or a stopped change

steps.what: Commit the exact checked database change and staged data version through the existing authorised release process
inputs: Exact complete version validated in s4 and actual existing release authority
outputs: Actually committed research database version, or a failed release result

tasks.design: Use native {DATA_PLATFORM} schema and import configuration first, with a bounded drafting loop only for required custom database code. Keep genetics data design, exact mapping specification, known-data validation and the complete final release decision with the geneticist before committing the checked version.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual database change can combine repetitive implementation and source loading with demanding scientific data design.
tasks.enabler_now: Native database imports handle exact selected records, while bounded code drafting can assist a fully specified custom change in an isolated test copy.
tasks.still_hard: A syntactically valid query can silently change biological meaning, provenance or permitted access.
tasks.human_edge: Define the actual scientific data relationships and verify the change against known research records.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: databases support explicit schema configuration and imports; model-drafted custom queries require inspection and tests against independently known outcomes before release.

assumptions: This illustrative research-database change includes actual design, implementation and manual source loading. Shares are unmeasured, independent of the supplied prior and cannot represent every maintenance duty without observing its mix.

The geneticist designs and captures actual requirements, source selections, explicit mappings and known expected outputs in s1. No clean genetic dataset, schema design, test oracle or source permission is produced for free.

Try native database features first. Existing imports, pipelines and unattended query runtime are baseline; their existing labour reduction is not new saving. Where native settings suffice, omit the model loop and measure the actual alternative.

The loop only drafts implementation, not clinical interpretation, genetic result sign-off or source-data values. Every changed mapping is inspected; missing or incompatible sources stop for retained manual resolution.

s3 operates only on a draft test copy. Actual live schema and data effects occur only at s5 after complete final validation in s4. Changes invalidate that gate; ordinary existing release authority is required and any additional owner review must inspect the final version with its labour added.
The final same-system commit is negligible and earns no saving. No hidden data export, external notification, clinical release or separate access grant occurs.
unknowns: Actual custom-code requirement, existing imports and release process
research_questions: Can one actual database change be reproduced and validated against known records using native features before adding a drafting loop?

already_counted.description: Actual scientific data design, remaining implementation and full known-data and access validation remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain drafting context and import contracts and independently test regressions and source-version exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete database implementation and data version validated in s4, including actual access and rollback checks; any change invalidates the gate.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=67.5; gross saving=32.5 from actual implementation drafting and exact staged import. Deduct 5 incremental hours once for net 27.5. Existing automation, runtime and the release commit earn no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop actual endangered species breeding or survival plans

steps.what: Locate and read actual species, pedigree, population and conservation programme records and capture selected relevant source data
inputs: Actual species records and existing programme objectives
Existing species pedigree and conservation database, defined as OTHER
outputs: Actual selected source evidence and captured pedigree and population data with gaps

steps.what: Develop actual genetic and conservation objectives with programme colleagues and capture the explicit selected pedigree comparison definitions
inputs: Actual evidence and gaps from s1
Actual programme constraints and colleague expertise
outputs: Human-selected objectives, comparison definitions and feasible planning constraints

steps.what: Calculate the exact selected pedigree and population comparisons using existing native methods and the explicit human definitions
inputs: Actual selected data captured in s1
Explicit comparison definitions captured in s2 and existing verified calculation method
outputs: Draft reproducible pedigree and population comparisons with missing evidence visible

steps.what: Interpret the actual comparisons, develop the programme contribution and write and check its entire final recommendations, evidence and limits
inputs: Actual comparisons from s3, original records and programme constraints
outputs: Complete actual human-authored and checked breeding or survival plan contribution with uncertainties

steps.what: Save the exact checked programme contribution as an actual planning draft
inputs: Exact complete final contribution checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual plan contribution with draft status and uncertainty preserved

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} source views and exact selected pedigree comparisons to support actual programme development. Keep conservation objectives, colleague discussion, interpretation and complete plan-contribution writing and checking human in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual programme contribution can require repeated source navigation and manual comparison calculations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native pedigree tools can calculate explicit selected comparisons from actual records.
tasks.still_hard: Genetic diversity alone does not determine a feasible or appropriate species survival plan.
tasks.human_edge: Weigh genetic evidence with husbandry, population and conservation constraints.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: pedigree databases can calculate selected population and relationship comparisons while conservation goals and breeding programme choices require expert judgement.

assumptions: This conditional programme-development episode includes actual manually constructed pedigree comparisons. Shares are illustrative, not measured or based on the supplied prior.

Existing collection staff produce original records as baseline work. The geneticist locates, reads, verifies and captures selected data in s1 and develops actual objectives and explicit calculation choices with colleagues in s2. No free complete pedigree, inferred parentage or new mathematical method is assumed.
Try native pedigree tools first. Existing calculations and runtime are baseline and earn no new gain. Uncertain pedigree or incompatible records stay visible and require retained human assessment.
All actual plan reasoning, recommendation writing and full final checking remain in s4. This saves an actual draft contribution, not an authorised breeding, animal movement or programme release.

The final contribution exists before its complete check and negligible separate save. Actual final programme approval or external issue must be separate checked actions with their labour counted if they occur; no animal operation is silently performed.
unknowns: Actual native pedigree reporting and programme approval workflow
research_questions: Which exact comparisons are still manually assembled during an actual plan contribution?

already_counted.description: Remaining source work, programme objective development and full interpretation and plan writing and checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain verified source mappings and comparison definitions and review incomplete-pedigree exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete plan contribution checked in s4, with actual draft status and uncertainties; edits invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=71; gross saving=29 from actual source lookup and manual comparisons. Deduct 4 incremental hours once for net 25. Conservation decisions, existing calculations and the save earn no new gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan species collection acquisition, distribution, maintenance or regeneration

steps.what: Inspect actual collection inventories, viability and maintenance records and consult curators to capture current holdings and programme constraints
inputs: Actual collection inventory and records and curator information
Existing species collection management system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Actual verified holdings, condition evidence, explicit identifiers and curatorial constraints

steps.what: Plan the actual acquisition, distribution, maintenance and regeneration priorities from collection needs and species biology
inputs: Actual verified collection evidence and constraints from s1
outputs: Human-selected curatorial priorities, activities, timing and reasons captured for the actual plan

steps.what: Fill exact selected collection identifiers, holdings and human-selected activity fields into the native curatorial plan template
inputs: Actual verified source fields captured in s1
Explicit activity selections and timing captured in s2
outputs: Draft curatorial plan with exact selected collection and activity fields

steps.what: Write the actual curatorial programme explanation and check the entire final plan for species needs, activities, timing, feasibility and evidence
inputs: Actual plan draft from s3, actual decisions and original collection records
outputs: Exact complete checked actual curatorial programme draft with limits and unresolved issues

steps.what: Save the exact checked curatorial programme draft
inputs: Exact complete final draft checked in s4

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} collection fields in the actual {DOCS} curatorial plan template from holdings and activities verified and selected by the geneticist. Keep species-specific programme choices, substantive plan writing and the complete final feasibility check human before saving the actual draft.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual curatorial plans can repeat collection identifiers, holdings and selected activity fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native collection records and plan templates can reuse these exact selected fields.
tasks.still_hard: Species biology, viability, capacity and collection purpose determine feasible curatorial priorities.
tasks.human_edge: Decide which actual holdings need acquisition, maintenance or regeneration and explain why.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: collection management records can populate exact plan fields while species-specific curatorial priorities and feasibility remain expert decisions.

assumptions: This conditional planning episode contains actual repeated collection and selected-activity fields in a real plan. Shares are unmeasured and independent of the supplied prior.

Curators' original collection records are baseline work; the geneticist actually verifies their evidence and captures all selected fields and constraints in s1. Actual activities and timing are chosen and captured in s2. No free current inventory or automatically inferred viability is assumed.

Try native records and template fields first. Existing field reuse is baseline and earns no additional gain. Missing or contradictory collection evidence remains exposed for retained manual resolution.
All substantive programme wording and full final meaning and feasibility checks remain in s4. Save is negligible and earns no gain; changed plan fields invalidate the check.

Planning does not itself acquire, distribute, maintain or regenerate material. Any actual order, transfer, programme approval, release or notice requires its own complete final-version check and gated action with actual labour counted; none occurs silently here.
If the same actual source capture or programme contribution also occurs in 16820, count it once.
unknowns: Actual collection-system fields and programme approval process
research_questions: Which exact collection and activity fields are manually repeated in an observed curatorial plan?

already_counted.description: Actual collection verification, species-specific programme decisions and complete plan writing and checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain exact collection-to-plan mappings and review stale or conflicting record exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete curatorial programme draft checked in s4 against actual holdings and species needs; changes invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross saving=20 from actual repeated plan fields. Deduct 3 incremental hours once for net 17. Curatorial decisions, physical collection activities and the save earn no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Specify and independently validate database changes
Maintain explicit pedigree and collection mappings
Distinguish plan preparation from authorised biological actions
role.ambitious_version: A geneticist reduces verified data transfer, implementation drafting and repetitive plan fields while retaining scientific database design, species judgement and complete final validation.
